edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ drives the _releaseStartTime assignment.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ drives the _releaseEndTime computation.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
Constructor validates _releaseEndTime against block.timestamp.
Constructor calls _msgSender() (msg.sender) to seed the initial owner via _setOwner.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is used to round the release start time in the constructor.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance reads _totalBenefit for the pro-rata computation.
Release amount depends entirely on the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
releasedBalance derives passedDays from the timestamps.
releasedBalance derives totalDays from the release window.
passedDays is a factor of the multiplication in the release formula.
_totalBenefit is a factor of the multiplication in the release formula.
The multiplication/division result is returned by releasedBalance.
unreleasedBalance reads _totalBenefit.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance to compute the remainder.
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
withdraw calls releasedBalance twice to determine the withdrawable amount.
withdraw reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the delta.
withdraw computes local amount = releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw updates _withdrawedBalance by adding the withdrawn amount.
Computed amount is passed to the external token safeTransfer.
Beneficiary address is the recipient of the external token transfer.
Held token contract is the target of the external call.
Malicious token can re-enter withdraw during the external safeTransfer call.
isNotTerminated modifier guards terminate.
onlyOwner modifier restricts terminate to the contract owner.
terminate uses block.timestamp to fix _releaseEndTime and released amount.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY rounds block.timestamp down to a day boundary in terminate.
terminate calls releasedBalance to freeze the released amount.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate rewrites _releaseEndTime to the current day boundary.
terminate sets the _isTerminated flag to true.
terminate computes amountToWithdraw from contract balance and remaining benefit.
Computed unreleased amount is passed to the external token safeTransfer.
owner() result is the recipient of the external token transfer.
Held token contract is the target of the external call in terminate.
Malicious token can re-enter terminate during the external safeTransfer call.
onlyOwner compares owner() with the untrusted _msgSender().
onlyOwner reads owner() to validate the caller.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
newOwner parameter is validated then forwarded in transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates the state change to _setOwner.
newOwner parameter flows into _setOwner via transferOwnership.
_setOwner uses its newOwner parameter to overwrite _owner.
